d:
Watch the hilarious comedy film "Mujhse Shaadi Karogi" in 4K on your TV for the best experience! Starring Salman Khan, Priyanka Chopra, Akshay Kumar, and Rajpal Yadav, this movie is a must-watch for comedy lovers.
A hot-headed man, Sameer, moves to Goa, where he meets and falls for Rani. However, Sunny, his roommate, also loves her and tries his best to ruin Sameer's chances with Rani.
Mujhse Shaadi Karogi is a 2004 Hindi-language romantic comedy film directed by David Dhawan and produced by Sajid Nadiadwala.
